# RTK

Source: https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk (Apache-2.0, LICENSE alongside this file).
Consulted at commit `b8cb15167268b7a27519b84f79e53c4cb742bafe` (2026-11-22).

TokenWise's built-in filters are TokenWise code. For some commands, the
choice of what a filter folds was informed by how RTK treats that command,
and some test inputs in `packages/core/test` are adapted from RTK's filter
tests and fixtures; each such test says so where it uses them. No RTK code
runs in TokenWise.
